guide.summary: Many characters differ by one stroke or one radical, and a slip turns one word into another: 已经 is not 自己, 周末 is not 未来. The idea that makes it click: the radical (the left or top part) carries the meaning, so ask what the word is about. Eyes take 目 (眼睛), the sun takes 日 (晴天), water takes 氵 (清楚), speech takes 讠 (请). Where no radical differs, learn the one stroke that differs as a picture: a crow 乌 has no eye.

subs.label: Open or closed, long or short stroke
subs.focus: 己 / 已 / 巳, 未 / 末, 土 / 士, 干 / 千 / 于, 午 / 牛. Items test 自己 vs 已经, 周末 vs 未来, 护士, 干净 / 一千 / 终于, 下午 vs 牛奶. Typical error: 己经 for 已经, 周未 for 周末.

subs.label: Strokes added to 人, 大 and 日
subs.focus: 人 / 入 / 八, 大 / 太 / 犬 / 天 / 夫, 日 / 目 / 白 / 自. Items test 入口, 太热, 今天, 丈夫, 生日, 题目, 明白, 自己. Typical error: 人口 for 入口, 大热了 for 太热了, 目己 for 自己.

subs.label: One dot or piece more
subs.focus: 买 / 卖, 我 / 找, 牛 / 半, 刀 / 力, 鸟 / 乌, 贝 / 见, 今 / 令. Items test buy vs sell (the sentence must force which), 找东西, 七点半, 努力, 小鸟 vs 乌云, 再见, 今天 vs 令人. Typical error: 卖 for 买, 我 for 找.

subs.label: Families of 青 and 主
subs.focus: 请 / 清 / 情 / 晴 / 睛 / 精 and 住 / 往 / 注 / 主. Items test the radical chosen by meaning: 请问, 清楚, 心情, 晴天, 眼睛, 精彩; 住在, 往前走, 注意, 主要. Typical error: 眼晴 for 眼睛, 住前走 for 往前走.

subs.label: Same right part, radical decides
subs.focus: 他 / 她 / 它 / 地 / 池, 那 / 哪, 很 / 根 / 跟 / 狠, 喝 / 渴, 快 / 块 / 筷, 蓝 / 篮. Items test the meaning radical: 她 for a woman, 哪 in questions, 跟 for 'with', 渴 for thirst, 一块钱, 筷子, 篮球. Typical error: 那国人 for 哪国人, 渴水 for 喝水.

subs.label: What sits inside or below
subs.focus: 问 / 间 / 闻 / 们 / 闪, 休 / 体, 洒 / 酒, 泪 / 汨, 爱 / 受, 外 / 处, 乐 / 东 / 车. Items test 问题, 时间, 新闻, 我们, 休息, 身体, 喝酒, 眼泪, 难受, 外面, 好处, 快乐, 东西, 汽车. Typical error: 体息 for 休息, 喝洒 for 喝酒.

subs.label: HSK 4 pairs split by radical
subs.focus: 拔 / 拨, 辩 / 辨 / 辫, 练 / 炼, 历 / 厉, 候 / 侯. Items test 锻炼 vs 练习, 辩论 vs 分辨 vs 辫子, 历史 vs 厉害, 时候, 拔牙 vs 拨电话. Typical error: 锻练 for 锻炼, 历害 for 厉害, 时侯 for 时候.

subs.label: HSK 4 pairs fixed by the word
subs.focus: 既 / 即, 竟 / 竞, 须 / 需, 象 / 像 / 向. Items test 既然 vs 立即, 竟然 vs 竞争, 必须 vs 需要, 好像 / 像 vs 大象 / 印象 vs 方向 / 向. Typical error: 竞然 for 竟然, 必需 for 必须 before a verb, 好象 for 好像.

rules.rule: 己 jǐ (self) is open at the top left, 已 yǐ (already) is half closed, 巳 sì is fully closed. 末 mò (end) and 士 shì have the long line on top; 未 wèi (not yet) and 土 tǔ have it at the bottom.
rules.pattern: 自己 · 已经 · 周末 · 未来 · 护士 · 土豆

examples.py: wǒ zì jǐ zuò fàn
tā yǐ jīng zǒu le
zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ máng ma
tā shì yī wèi hù shi

rules.note: Rhyme: 己 open, 已 half, 巳 full. 巳 is almost never in HSK words; if you think you need it, you want 已. 末 is a tree 木 with its tip marked by the long top line: the end. 土 is the wide ground at the bottom.

rules.rule: 干 gān has two flat lines and a straight stroke down; 千 qiān starts with a slanted stroke on top; 于 yú ends in a hook. 午 wǔ stops at the top line; 牛 niú pokes through it, like a horn.
rules.pattern: 干净 · 一千 · 终于 · 关于 · 下午 · 牛奶

examples.py: fáng jiān hěn gān jìng
tā zhōng yú lái le
wǒ men xià wǔ jiàn
wǒ měi tiān hē niú nǎi

rules.note: At this level 千 means 'thousand' (一千, 两千). 于 is in 终于, 关于, 对于, 由于. 干 is in 干净 and 干什么 (gàn).

rules.rule: 人 rén leans on its long left stroke, 入 rù (enter) on its long right one; 八 bā's strokes do not touch. 大 plus a top line is 天; plus a dot below is 太. 夫 has two lines and its slant pokes out above both.
rules.pattern: 入口 · 今天 · 太好了 · 丈夫 · 生日 · 题目 · 明白 · 自己

examples.py: rù kǒu zài nǎ r
jīn tiān tài rè le
tā zhàng fu shì yī shēng
zhè ge tí mù hěn nán

rules.note: 日 rì (sun, day) has one line inside, 目 mù (eye) two and is taller. A dot on top turns 日 into 白 (明白, 白色) and 目 into 自 (自己). 犬 quǎn (dog) has its dot at the top right; it is rare at HSK 1 to 4.

rules.rule: One extra piece flips the word. 卖 mài (sell) is 买 mǎi (buy) with 十 on top. 找 zhǎo has a plain hand 扌; 我 adds a slant on top of it. 力 lì pokes above its top line, 刀 dāo does not. 鸟 niǎo has an eye dot, 乌 wū none.
rules.pattern: 买东西 · 卖菜 · 找手机 · 努力 · 一把刀 · 小鸟 · 乌云

examples.py: tā zài shì chǎng mài cài
examples.en: He sells vegetables at the market.

examples.py: wǒ zài zhǎo wǒ de shǒu jī
tā xué xí hěn nǔ lì
tiān shàng yǒu hěn duō wū yún
examples.en: There are a lot of dark clouds in the sky.

rules.note: 多了就卖，少了就买: with more on top (十) you sell. The crow is black, so you cannot see its eye. 半 bàn (half) has two dots on top, 牛 one slanted stroke. 见 jiàn ends in a hooked foot, 贝 bèi in a dot. 今 jīn (今天) ends like a 7, 令 lìng (令人) in 卩.

rules.rule: 青 gives the sound qing or jing; the radical gives the meaning: 讠 speech 请 (please, invite), 氵 water 清 (clear), 忄 heart 情 (feeling), 日 sun 晴 (sunny), 目 eye 睛 (eye), 米 rice 精 (refined; 精彩 brilliant).
rules.pattern: 请 · 清楚 · 心情 · 晴天 · 眼睛 · 精彩

examples.py: wǒ qǐng nǐ hē chá
jīn tiān shì qíng tiān
tā de yǎn jing hěn dà
wǒ tīng bù qīng chu

rules.note: 情 and 晴 are both qíng, 睛 and 精 both jīng, so the sound will not save you; only the meaning will. Weather is the sun: 晴. Eyes are the eye: 睛.

rules.rule: 主 is the base. With 亻 person: 住 zhù (live, stay). With 彳 step: 往 wǎng (toward). With 氵 water: 注 zhù (pour, as in 注意). Alone: 主 zhǔ (主要, 主意).
rules.pattern: 住在 · 往前走 · 注意 · 主要 · 主意

examples.py: wǒ zhù zài běi jīng
wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù dào le
guò mǎ lù yào zhù yì ān quán
examples.en: Be careful when you cross the road.

examples.py: zhè shì wǒ de zhǔ yi

rules.note: 住 and 往 differ only on the left: 亻 has one slanted stroke, 彳 two. A person lives somewhere (住); steps go somewhere (往). 住 and 注 sound the same, zhù: 注意 is attention poured like water.

rules.rule: The left part tells the meaning: 他 (he) person 亻, 她 (she) woman 女, 它 (it) for animals and things, 地 (ground; de before a verb) earth 土, 池 (pool) water 氵. 哪 nǎ (which) is 那 nà (that) plus an asking mouth 口.
rules.pattern: 他 · 她 · 它 · 高兴地 · 游泳池 · 那儿 / 哪儿

examples.zh: 我家有一只狗，它很可爱。
examples.py: wǒ jiā yǒu yī zhī gǒu tā hěn kě ài
examples.en: We have a dog at home; it's very cute.

examples.py: tā gāo xìng de xiào le
nǐ zhù zài nǎ r
wǒ men qù yóu yǒng chí yóu yǒng ba
examples.en: Let's go swimming at the pool.

rules.note: 他, 她 and 它 all sound tā; only the English cue (he, she, it) decides. In a question asking which or where, write 哪; when pointing (that, there), write 那.

rules.rule: Same right part, the radical decides: 跟 gēn (with, follow) has a foot, 根 gēn (root; measure for sticks) wood 木, 很 hěn (very) the step 彳, 狠 hěn (ruthless) the animal 犭. 喝 hē (drink) has a mouth, 渴 kě (thirsty) water.
rules.pattern: 跟 · 一根 · 很好 · 喝水 · 口渴 · 一块钱 · 筷子 · 篮球

examples.py: wǒ gēn mā ma qù chāo shì
examples.en: I'm going to the supermarket with Mum.

examples.zh: 他口渴了，喝了一大杯水。
examples.py: tā kǒu kě le hē le yī dà bēi shuǐ
examples.en: He was thirsty and drank a big glass of water.

examples.py: wǒ yòng kuài zi chī fàn
wǒ xǐ huan dǎ lán qiú

rules.note: 快 kuài (fast, happy) has the heart 忄, 块 kuài (piece; yuan) earth 土, 筷 kuài (chopstick) bamboo on top. 蓝 lán (blue) has grass 艹, from a dye plant; 篮 lán (basket) has bamboo: a basket is woven from bamboo.

rules.rule: What sits inside 门 decides: mouth 口 问 wèn (ask), sun 日 间 jiān (time, room), ear 耳 闻 wén (news, smell), person 人 闪 shǎn (flash). 们 men has 亻 beside 门. 休 xiū (rest) is 亻+木, 体 tǐ (body) 亻+本.
rules.pattern: 问题 · 时间 · 房间 · 新闻 · 我们 · 休息 · 身体

examples.zh: 我可以问你一个问题吗？
examples.py: wǒ kě yǐ wèn nǐ yī ge wèn tí ma
examples.en: Can I ask you a question?

examples.py: nǐ yǒu shí jiān ma
wǒ měi tiān kàn xīn wén
examples.en: I watch the news every day.

examples.py: tā shēn tǐ hěn hǎo

rules.note: A mouth at the door asks (问); sunlight through the door gap is a space or a stretch of time (间); an ear at the door hears (闻). A person leaning on a tree 木 rests (休); 体 has the extra line of 本.

rules.rule: Small inner differences: 酒 jiǔ (alcohol) has 酉, a jar with an extra line inside; 洒 sǎ (sprinkle) only 西. 泪 lèi (tears) is water from the eye 目; 汨 has 日. 爱 ài (love) has 友 at the bottom, 受 shòu (bear, receive) only 又.
rules.pattern: 喝酒 · 眼泪 · 爱 · 难受 · 外面 · 好处 · 快乐 · 东西 · 汽车

examples.py: bà ba bù hē jiǔ
tā liú xià le yǎn lèi
wǒ ài wǒ de jiā
xué hàn yǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎo chù

rules.note: 外 wài starts with 夕; 处 chù starts with 夂, whose long sweep runs under 卜. 乐 lè starts with a slanted stroke, 东 dōng with a flat line; both have two small feet. 车 chē has no feet and a line at the bottom. 汨 mì is only in the river name 汨罗.

rules.rule: Same sound, the radical gives the meaning. 炼 liàn has fire 火 (锻炼, work out), 练 liàn silk 纟 (练习, practise). 辩 biàn has speech 讠 (辩论, debate), 辨 a dot and slash like a knife (分辨, tell apart), 辫 silk 纟 (辫子, braid).
rules.pattern: 锻炼 · 练习 · 辩论 · 分辨 · 厉害 · 历史 · 时候

examples.py: wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang duàn liàn shēn tǐ
tā de hàn yǔ hěn lì hai
tā men zài biàn lùn zhè ge wèn tí
nǐ shén me shí hou huí lái

rules.note: 历 lì (历史, 经历) has 力 under 厂; 厉 lì (厉害) has 万. 拔 bá (pull out: 拔牙) differs from 拨 bō (dial, push aside), whose right side is 发. 候 hòu (时候, 问候) has a short vertical after 亻 that 侯 hóu, a surname, lacks.

rules.rule: 必须 xū (must) has hair 彡 and head 页; 需要 xū (need) has rain 雨 on top. 竟然 jìng has 音 over 儿; 竞争 jìng has 立 over 兄. 像 xiàng (resemble, seem) has a person 亻; 象 is the elephant; 向 means toward.
rules.pattern: 必须 · 需要 · 竟然 · 竞争 · 好像 · 大象 · 方向

examples.py: wǒ men bì xū mǎ shàng chū fā
examples.en: We must set off right away.

examples.py: nǐ xū yào bāng máng ma
tā jìng rán wàng le wǒ de shēng rì
tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng tā mā ma
examples.en: She looks a lot like her mother.

rules.note: 象 also writes the 'image' words 印象, 现象, 形象. 必需 (necessary: 必需品) exists, but 'must' before a verb is 必须. 既 jì (既然) ends in 旡: the eater has turned away, done. 即 jí (立即, 即使) ends in 卩: kneeling to eat now.

right.py: wǒ yǐ jīng chī fàn le

contrasts.why: 已经 (already) needs 已, whose left stroke rises halfway. 己 (fully open) is 'self', as in 自己.

right.py: zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ yǒu kòng ma

contrasts.why: 周末 is the end of the week: 末 has the long line on top, the tip of the tree. 未 (short top line) means 'not yet', as in 未来.
A question about which needs 哪 nǎ, with the asking mouth 口. 那 nà only points: that.

right.py: tā de yǎn jing hěn piào liang

contrasts.why: 眼睛 is about eyes, so it takes the eye radical 目: 睛. 晴 with the sun 日 is sunny weather, as in 晴天.

right.py: wǒ kě le xiǎng hē shuǐ
right.en: I'm thirsty; I want to drink some water.

contrasts.why: Drinking is done with the mouth: 喝 has 口. 渴 with water 氵 is the feeling of thirst.

right.py: nǐ lèi le jiù xiū xi yī xià ba
right.en: If you're tired, take a rest.

contrasts.why: 休息 is a person 亻 leaning on a tree 木: 休. 体 (亻 + 本, with an extra line) is the body, as in 身体.

right.py: yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu jiù dào le
right.en: Go straight ahead and you'll get there.

contrasts.why: Toward is 往, with the step radical 彳 (two slanted strokes). 住 with a single 亻 means to live somewhere.

contrasts.wrong: 他每天下午去公园锻练。

right.zh: 他每天下午去公园锻炼。
right.py: tā měi tiān xià wǔ qù gōng yuán duàn liàn
right.en: He works out in the park every afternoon.

contrasts.why: 锻炼 comes from forging metal, so it takes fire 火: 炼. 练 with silk 纟 is for 练习, practising.

contrasts.wrong: 我想卖一本书送给妈妈。

right.zh: 我想买一本书送给妈妈。
right.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī běn shū sòng gěi mā ma
right.en: I want to buy a book to give to my mum.

contrasts.why: You get a book in order to give it, so it is 买, buy. 卖 has the extra 十 on top: with more, you sell.
竟然 (unexpectedly) is 竟, with 音 (日 in the middle) over 儿. 竞 with 口 in the middle (兄) is for 竞争, compete.

cheat: 已经: half shut 已. 自己: wide open 己. Fully closed 巳 is almost never what you want.
Long line on top: 末 (周末), 士 (护士). Long line at the bottom: 未 (未来), 土.
青 family by meaning: speech 请, water 清, heart 情, sun 晴, eye 睛, rice 精.
Asking? Add a mouth: 哪, 问. Pointing? 那.
Mouth drinks 喝, water is thirst 渴. Fire works out 锻炼, silk practises 练习.
Rest is a person by a tree: 休. Toward is two steps: 往. Live is one person: 住.
More on top sells: 卖. The black crow 乌 has no eye.

items.q: 我___经吃过午饭了。
items.zh: 我已经吃过午饭了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng chī guo wǔ fàn le
items.en: I've already had lunch.
items.why: 已经 'already' is written with 已, whose left stroke closes halfway. 己 (fully open) is 'self' in 自己, and 巳 (closed) is almost never needed. Rhyme: 己 open, 已 half, 巳 full.

items.q: 早饭我喝了一杯热___奶。
items.zh: 早饭我喝了一杯热牛奶。
items.py: zǎo fàn wǒ hē le yī bēi rè niú nǎi
items.en: I had a cup of hot milk for breakfast.
items.why: 牛奶 is cow's milk, and 牛 has its vertical stroke poking through the top line like a horn. 午 stops at the line: it is noon, as in 下午. 午奶 is not a word.

items.q: 这个周___我们公司有一场篮球比赛。
items.zh: 这个周末我们公司有一场篮球比赛。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men gōng sī yǒu yī chǎng lán qiú bǐ sài
items.en: This weekend our company has a basketball game.
items.why: 周末 is the end of the week, and 末 has the long line on top, like the tip of a tree. 未 has a short line on top and means 'not yet' (未来), so 周未 is not a word.

items.q: ___来的手机可能会越来越聪明。
items.zh: 未来的手机可能会越来越聪明。
items.py: wèi lái de shǒu jī kě néng huì yuè lái yuè cōng míng
items.en: Future phones may get smarter and smarter.
items.why: 未来 'the future' is written with 未: short line on top, longer line below ('not yet'). 末 is the end (周末, 月末), and 末来 is not a word.

items.q: 请把杯子洗___净。
items.zh: 请把杯子洗干净。
items.py: qǐng bǎ bēi zi xǐ gān jìng
items.en: Please wash the cup clean.
items.why: 干净 (clean) is written with 干: two flat lines and a straight stroke down. 千 (thousand) starts with a slanting stroke and 于 ends in a hook, so 洗千净 and 洗于净 are not words.

items.q: 他练了三个月，终___学会了游泳。
items.zh: 他练了三个月，终于学会了游泳。
items.py: tā liàn le sān ge yuè zhōng yú xué huì le yóu yǒng
items.en: After three months of practice, he finally learned to swim.
items.why: 终于 'finally' ends in 于, whose bottom stroke hooks like a fish hook. 千 and 干 have no hook, so 终千 and 终干 are not words.

items.q: 这双运动鞋要两___块。
items.zh: 这双运动鞋要两千块。
items.py: zhè shuāng yùn dòng xié yào liǎng qiān kuài
items.en: This pair of sports shoes costs two thousand yuan.
items.why: 千 (thousand) starts with a slanting stroke on top; 干 starts flat and 于 hooks at the bottom. Only 千 gives 两千块, 'two thousand yuan'.

items.q: 关___这次足球比赛的新规则，请大家认真看一下通知。
items.zh: 关于这次足球比赛的新规则，请大家认真看一下通知。
items.py: guān yú zhè cì zú qiú bǐ sài de xīn guī zé qǐng dà jiā rèn zhēn kàn yī xià tōng zhī
items.en: Please read the notice carefully about the new rules for this football match.
items.why: 关于 'about, regarding' ends in 于 with its hooked stroke. 干 and 千 are different characters, so 关干 and 关千 do not exist. Think of a fish hook: 于.

items.q: 她在医院当护___，每天都很忙。
items.zh: 她在医院当护士，每天都很忙。
items.py: tā zài yī yuàn dāng hù shi měi tiān dōu hěn máng
items.en: She works as a nurse in a hospital and is busy every day.
items.why: 护士 'nurse' has 士, with the long line on top. 土 (earth) has the long line at the bottom, like the ground. 护土 is not a word.

items.q: 晚饭我想做___豆炖牛肉。
items.zh: 晚饭我想做土豆炖牛肉。
items.py: wǎn fàn wǒ xiǎng zuò tǔ dòu dùn niú ròu
items.en: For dinner I want to make beef stewed with potatoes.
items.why: 土豆 'potato' grows in the earth: 土 has the long line at the bottom, like the ground. 士 has it on top, as in 护士. 士豆 is not a word.

items.q: 他不喜欢点外卖，每天下班回家以后都___做饭。
items.zh: 他不喜欢点外卖，每天下班回家以后都自己做饭。
items.py: tā bù xǐ huan diǎn wài mài měi tiān xià bān huí jiā yǐ hòu dōu zì jǐ zuò fàn
items.en: He doesn't like ordering takeout; every day after work he cooks for himself at home.
items.why: 自己 'oneself' ends in 己, wide open at the top left. 已 is half closed and belongs in 已经; 自已 and 自巳 are not words. Open 己 for yourself.

items.s: 会议己经开始了，请大家安静。
items.s_py: huì yì jǐ jīng kāi shǐ le qǐng dà jiā ān jìng
items.zh: 会议已经开始了，请大家安静。
items.py: huì yì yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le qǐng dà jiā ān jìng
items.en: The meeting has already started; please be quiet.
items.why: 已经 'already' needs 已, half closed; 己 is fully open and is 'self' (自己). 己经 is not a word. Remember: 已 is half shut.

items.s: 冰箱里还有一盒午奶。
items.s_py: bīng xiāng lǐ hái yǒu yī hé wǔ nǎi
items.zh: 冰箱里还有一盒牛奶。
items.py: bīng xiāng lǐ hái yǒu yī hé niú nǎi
items.en: There is still a carton of milk in the fridge.
items.why: Milk is 牛奶: 牛 has its vertical stroke poking through the top line like a horn. 午 stops at the line (下午, noon). 午奶 is not a word.

items.s: 下午我们公司有一个会议。
items.zh: 下午我们公司有一个会议。
items.py: xià wǔ wǒ men gōng sī yǒu yī ge huì yì
items.en: We have a meeting at our company this afternoon.
items.why: Correct: 下午 'afternoon' is written with 午, whose vertical stroke stops at the top line. 牛 pokes through it and means cow. Only the cow's stroke has a horn.

items.q: 请从这个___口进去，出口在后面。
items.zh: 请从这个入口进去，出口在后面。
items.py: qǐng cóng zhè ge rù kǒu jìn qù chū kǒu zài hòu miàn
items.en: Please go in through this entrance; the exit is at the back.
items.why: 入口 'entrance' is the opposite of 出口; 入 has its long stroke on the right, like an arrow going in. 人 leans on its left stroke and gives 人口, population; 八 is the number eight.

items.q: 这件外套___大了，我想换小一点的。
items.zh: 这件外套太大了，我想换小一点的。
items.py: zhè jiàn wài tào tài dà le wǒ xiǎng huàn xiǎo yī diǎn de
items.en: This coat is too big; I'd like to swap it for a smaller one.
items.why: 太 + adjective + 了 means 'too ...'. 太 is 大 with a dot underneath: a dot of 'too much'. 大大了 and 夫大了 make no sense here.

items.q: 今___是星期六，我们去打羽毛球。
items.zh: 今天是星期六，我们去打羽毛球。
items.py: jīn tiān shì xīng qī liù wǒ men qù dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.en: Today is Saturday; let's go play badminton.
items.why: 今天 'today' has 天: 大 with a line on top, the sky above a person. 大 (big) and 夫 do not fit, and 今大 is not a word.

items.q: 她的丈___是一位厨师，做的菜特别好吃。
items.zh: 她的丈夫是一位厨师，做的菜特别好吃。
items.py: tā de zhàng fu shì yī wèi chú shī zuò de cài tè bié hǎo chī
items.en: Her husband is a chef, and the dishes he makes are especially delicious.
items.why: 丈夫 'husband' ends in 夫, whose top slant pokes out above two lines. 大 (big) and 天 (sky) give 丈大 and 丈天, which are not words.

items.q: 明天是我的生___，我想请朋友吃饭。
items.zh: 明天是我的生日，我想请朋友吃饭。
items.py: míng tiān shì wǒ de shēng rì wǒ xiǎng qǐng péng you chī fàn
items.en: Tomorrow is my birthday and I want to treat my friends to a meal.
items.why: 生日 'birthday' has 日, the sun or day, with one line inside. 目 (eye) is taller with two lines and 白 has a dot on top; 生目 and 生白 are not words.

items.q: 老师，这个题___我看不懂，能再说一遍吗？
items.zh: 老师，这个题目我看不懂，能再说一遍吗？
items.py: lǎo shī zhè ge tí mù wǒ kàn bù dǒng néng zài shuō yī biàn ma
items.en: Teacher, I can't understand this question; could you say it again?
items.why: 题目 'question, title' uses 目, the eye, since it is what you look at: taller, with two lines inside. 日 has one line and 白 a dot on top, so 题日 and 题白 are not words.

items.q: 你说得太快了，我不明___。
items.zh: 你说得太快了，我不明白。
items.py: nǐ shuō de tài kuài le wǒ bù míng bai
items.en: You're speaking too fast; I don't understand.
items.why: 明白 'understand' ends in 白: 日 with a slanted dot on top, like a bright white light. 日 and 自 are different characters, and 不明日 and 不明自 are not words.

items.q: 这个城市的___口有两千多万，所以路上总是很挤。
items.zh: 这个城市的人口有两千多万，所以路上总是很挤。
items.py: zhè ge chéng shì de rén kǒu yǒu liǎng qiān duō wàn suǒ yǐ lù shang zǒng shì hěn jǐ
items.en: This city has over twenty million people, so the roads are always crowded.
items.why: 人口 'population' has 人, which leans on its long left stroke. 入 leans the other way and means 'enter' (入口, entrance), which makes no sense with 两千多万. 八 is the number eight.

items.q: 我们公司早上___点上班。
items.zh: 我们公司早上八点上班。
items.py: wǒ men gōng sī zǎo shang bā diǎn shàng bān
items.en: Our company starts work at eight in the morning.
items.why: 八 'eight' has two strokes that do not touch, like legs apart. 人 and 入 have strokes that join at the top, so 人点 and 入点 are not times of day.

items.q: 我每天用手机写___记，记下有意思的事。
items.zh: 我每天用手机写日记，记下有意思的事。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān yòng shǒu jī xiě rì jì jì xià yǒu yì si de shì
items.en: I write a diary on my phone every day to record interesting things.
items.why: 日记 'diary' is a record of the days: 日 is the sun or day. 目 (eye) and 白 do not mean 'day', so 目记 and 白记 are not words. 日 is short and wide, 目 tall with two lines.

items.q: 夏___到了，我们常常去海边游泳。
items.zh: 夏天到了，我们常常去海边游泳。
items.py: xià tiān dào le wǒ men cháng cháng qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng
items.en: Summer has come and we often go swimming at the beach.
items.why: 夏天 'summer' ends in 天: 大 with a line on top, the sky. 夫 has a slant poking out and 大 has no top line, so 夏夫 and 夏大 are not words.

items.s: 这件毛衣大贵了，我不买。
items.s_py: zhè jiàn máo yī dà guì le wǒ bù mǎi
items.zh: 这件毛衣太贵了，我不买。
items.py: zhè jiàn máo yī tài guì le wǒ bù mǎi
items.en: This sweater is too expensive; I won't buy it.
items.why: 'Too expensive' is 太贵了: 太 is 大 with a dot underneath. 大贵 is not a way to say 'too'. The dot means too much.

items.s: 她穿了一件目色的衬衫，很好看。
items.s_py: tā chuān le yī jiàn mù sè de chèn shān hěn hǎo kàn
items.zh: 她穿了一件白色的衬衫，很好看。
items.py: tā chuān le yī jiàn bái sè de chèn shān hěn hǎo kàn
items.en: She wore a white shirt and it looked very nice.
items.why: 白色 'white' has 白: 日 with a slanted dot on top. 目 (eye) is taller with two lines inside, and 目色 is not a colour word. A dot on the sun makes it white.

items.s: 他把自己的手机借给了我。
items.zh: 他把自己的手机借给了我。
items.py: tā bǎ zì jǐ de shǒu jī jiè gěi le wǒ
items.en: He lent me his own phone.
items.why: Correct: 自己 'oneself' is 自 (目 with a dot on top) plus the open 己. It may look like a trap because 已 and 目 are close by, but both parts here are right.

items.q: 我想___一部新手机，可是钱不够。
items.zh: 我想买一部新手机，可是钱不够。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī bù xīn shǒu jī kě shì qián bú gòu
items.en: I want to buy a new phone, but I don't have enough money.
items.why: Not having enough money only stops you buying: 买 mǎi. 卖 (sell) is 买 with 十 on top: 多了就卖, 少了就买. A seller would not need money for the phone.

items.q: 他在网上___自己不用的旧手机，还赚了五百块。
items.zh: 他在网上卖自己不用的旧手机，还赚了五百块。
items.py: tā zài wǎng shàng mài zì jǐ bù yòng de jiù shǒu jī hái zhuàn le wǔ bǎi kuài
items.en: He sold the old phone he no longer uses online and even made five hundred yuan.
items.why: Earning 五百块 from a phone he does not use means he sold it: 卖 mài, with the extra 十 on top. 买 would be buying his own unused phone, which cannot earn money.

items.q: 我的钥匙不见了，我在___它。
items.zh: 我的钥匙不见了，我在找它。
items.py: wǒ de yào shi bú jiàn le wǒ zài zhǎo tā
items.en: My key is missing; I'm looking for it.
items.why: 'Look for' is 找 zhǎo: the hand 扌 with 戈 beside it. 我 (I) is the same shape with one extra slanting stroke on top. A missing key is something you look for, and 我在我它 means nothing.

items.q: 现在是七点___，我们该吃晚饭了。
items.zh: 现在是七点半，我们该吃晚饭了。
items.py: xiàn zài shì qī diǎn bàn wǒ men gāi chī wǎn fàn le
items.en: It's half past seven; time for dinner.
items.why: 'Half past' is 半 bàn, with two dots on top, like two halves. 牛 (cow) has one slanted stroke, and 七点牛 is not a time.

items.q: 足球比赛的上___场，我们一直在输球。
items.zh: 足球比赛的上半场，我们一直在输球。
items.py: zú qiú bǐ sài de shàng bàn chǎng wǒ men yī zhí zài shū qiú
items.en: In the first half of the football match we were losing all the time.
items.why: 上半场 is the first half of a match: 半 'half' has two dots on top. 牛 has one slanted stroke, so 上牛场 is not a word. Two dots, two halves.

items.q: 他每天练习跑步，非常努___。
items.zh: 他每天练习跑步，非常努力。
items.py: tā měi tiān liàn xí pǎo bù fēi cháng nǔ lì
items.en: He practises running every day and works very hard.
items.why: 努力 'work hard' ends in 力, whose slanted stroke pokes up above the top line like a strong arm. 刀 (knife) does not poke through; 努刀 is not a word.

items.q: 我用水果___切苹果。
items.zh: 我用水果刀切苹果。
items.py: wǒ yòng shuǐ guǒ dāo qiē píng guǒ
items.en: I cut the apple with a fruit knife.
items.why: A fruit knife is 水果刀: 刀 is a blade whose stroke does not poke above the top line. 力 (strength) pokes above it. 水果力 is not an object you cut with.

items.q: 树上有一只小___在唱歌。
items.zh: 树上有一只小鸟在唱歌。
items.py: shù shang yǒu yī zhī xiǎo niǎo zài chàng gē
items.en: There is a little bird singing in the tree.
items.why: A singing bird is 鸟 niǎo, with a dot for its eye. 乌 (crow, black) has no eye dot, because you cannot see a black crow's eye; 小乌 is not the word for a little bird.

items.q: 天上有一大片___云，可能要下大雨了。
items.zh: 天上有一大片乌云，可能要下大雨了。
items.py: tiān shang yǒu yī dà piàn wū yún kě néng yào xià dà yǔ le
items.en: There is a big patch of dark clouds in the sky; it may pour soon.
items.why: 乌云 'dark clouds' uses 乌, the black crow with no eye dot. 鸟 has the dot and means bird, so 鸟云 is not a word. Dark clouds, no dot.

items.q: 晚安，我们明天再___。
items.zh: 晚安，我们明天再见。
items.py: wǎn ān wǒ men míng tiān zài jiàn
items.en: Good night, see you again tomorrow.
items.why: 再见 'see you' ends in 见, whose last stroke is a hooked foot. 贝 (shell) ends in a dot, and 再贝 is not a word.

items.q: 他的表演精彩得___人难忘，大家都站起来鼓掌。
items.zh: 他的表演精彩得令人难忘，大家都站起来鼓掌。
items.py: tā de biǎo yǎn jīng cǎi de lìng rén nán wàng dà jiā dōu zhàn qǐ lái gǔ zhǎng
items.en: His performance was so brilliant it was unforgettable, and everyone stood up to applaud.
items.why: 令人 'makes people (feel)' is written 令, which ends in a dot over a vertical, like 卩. 今 (now, as in 今天) ends like a 7. 今人难忘 does not mean 'unforgettable'.

items.s: 我们在网上卖了一双球鞋，明天就能穿了。
items.s_py: wǒ men zài wǎng shàng mài le yī shuāng qiú xié míng tiān jiù néng chuān le
items.zh: 我们在网上买了一双球鞋，明天就能穿了。
items.py: wǒ men zài wǎng shàng mǎi le yī shuāng qiú xié míng tiān jiù néng chuān le
items.en: We bought a pair of sports shoes online and can wear them tomorrow.
items.why: Shoes you can wear tomorrow were bought: 买, with no 十 on top. 卖 means sell, so the sentence would say you sold the shoes, which cannot lead to wearing them.

items.s: 我的耳机不见了，你能帮我我一下吗？
items.s_py: wǒ de ěr jī bú jiàn le nǐ néng bāng wǒ wǒ yī xià ma
items.zh: 我的耳机不见了，你能帮我找一下吗？
items.py: wǒ de ěr jī bú jiàn le nǐ néng bāng wǒ zhǎo yī xià ma
items.en: My earphones are missing; can you help me look for them?
items.why: 'Help me look' is 帮我找一下: 找 has the hand radical 扌 and no slanting stroke on top. 我一下 repeats 'I' and means nothing.

items.s: 今天的天气不错，我们去公园放风筝吧。
items.zh: 今天的天气不错，我们去公园放风筝吧。
items.py: jīn tiān de tiān qì bù cuò wǒ men qù gōng yuán fàng fēng zheng ba
items.en: The weather is nice today; let's go fly a kite in the park.
items.why: Correct: 今天 'today' is written with 今, which ends like a 7. 令 ends in 卩 and belongs in 令人. Only 今 makes 今天.

items.q: ___问，地铁站怎么走？
items.zh: 请问，地铁站怎么走？
items.py: qǐng wèn dì tiě zhàn zěn me zǒu
items.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the subway station?
items.why: 请问 'may I ask' is polite speech, so it has the speech radical 讠: 请. 清 has water 氵 and 情 a heart 忄; 清问 and 情问 are not words.

items.q: 今天是___天，我们去爬山吧。
items.zh: 今天是晴天，我们去爬山吧。
items.py: jīn tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù pá shān ba
items.en: Today is a sunny day; let's go hiking.
items.why: Weather is about the sun, so 晴天 'sunny day' has 日: 晴. 清 (water) and 睛 (eye) share the part 青 but have the wrong meaning; 清天 and 睛天 are not words.

items.q: 我的小猫有一双大大的眼___。
items.zh: 我的小猫有一双大大的眼睛。
items.py: wǒ de xiǎo māo yǒu yī shuāng dà dà de yǎn jing
items.en: My kitten has a pair of big eyes.
items.why: 眼睛 'eyes' has the eye radical 目: 睛. 晴 has the sun and is for weather, so 眼晴 is the classic typo. Eyes take 目, sunshine takes 日.

items.q: 这个视频的声音不___楚，我听不懂。
items.zh: 这个视频的声音不清楚，我听不懂。
items.py: zhè ge shì pín de shēng yīn bù qīng chu wǒ tīng bù dǒng
items.en: The sound in this video isn't clear, and I can't understand it.
items.why: 清楚 'clear' has water 氵, like clear water: 清. 请 (speech) and 情 (heart) have the wrong meaning; 不请楚 and 不情楚 are not words.

items.q: 比赛赢了以后，大家的心___都特别好。
items.zh: 比赛赢了以后，大家的心情都特别好。
items.py: bǐ sài yíng le yǐ hòu dà jiā de xīn qíng dōu tè bié hǎo
items.en: After winning the match, everyone was in an especially good mood.
items.why: 心情 'mood' is about the heart, so it takes 忄: 情. 晴 (sun) sounds the same but 心晴 is not the word for mood, and 请 is speech. Feelings take the heart.

items.q: 昨天的足球赛太___彩了，我一直看到最后。
items.zh: 昨天的足球赛太精彩了，我一直看到最后。
items.py: zuó tiān de zú qiú sài tài jīng cǎi le wǒ yī zhí kàn dào zuì hòu
items.en: Yesterday's football match was so brilliant that I watched until the end.
items.why: 精彩 'brilliant' has rice 米 on the left (refined grain, the best part): 精. 请 has speech 讠 and 清 water 氵; 请彩 and 清彩 are not words. Brilliant = refined rice.

items.q: 我想___你吃晚饭，你有空吗？
items.zh: 我想请你吃晚饭，你有空吗？
items.py: wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ chī wǎn fàn nǐ yǒu kòng ma
items.en: I'd like to invite you to dinner; are you free?
items.why: 'Invite, treat' is 请: the speech radical 讠, because you ask someone. 清 has water and means clear, so 清你吃饭 makes no sense.

items.q: 我___在三楼，办公室在二楼。
items.zh: 我住在三楼，办公室在二楼。
items.py: wǒ zhù zài sān lóu bàn gōng shì zài èr lóu
items.en: I live on the third floor and the office is on the second.
items.why: 'Live (somewhere)' is 住: a person 亻 plus 主, since a person lives somewhere. 往 (彳, two slanted strokes) means toward and 注 (氵) means pour, so 往在 and 注在 do not work.

items.q: 出了地铁站，___右拐就是我们公司。
items.zh: 出了地铁站，往右拐就是我们公司。
items.py: chū le dì tiě zhàn wǎng yòu guǎi jiù shì wǒ men gōng sī
items.en: Come out of the subway station and turn right; our company is right there.
items.why: 'Toward' is 往: the step radical 彳 (two slanted strokes) is for going. 住 has a single 亻 and means live, so 住右拐 is not a direction.

items.q: 开车的时候要___意安全，不要看手机。
items.zh: 开车的时候要注意安全，不要看手机。
items.py: kāi chē de shí hou yào zhù yì ān quán bù yào kàn shǒu jī
items.en: When you drive, pay attention to safety and don't look at your phone.
items.why: 注意 'pay attention' has water 氵: 注, as if attention is poured onto something. 住 (亻) means live and 往 means toward, so 住意 and 往意 are not words.

items.q: 我的___要工作是接电话和写报告。
items.zh: 我的主要工作是接电话和写报告。
items.py: wǒ de zhǔ yào gōng zuò shì jiē diàn huà hé xiě bào gào
items.en: My main jobs are answering the phone and writing reports.
items.why: 主要 'main' is written with 主 alone, with no radical beside it. 住 and 注 add one, so 住要 and 注要 are not words.

items.s: 她的眼晴红红的，好像哭过。
items.s_py: tā de yǎn qíng hóng hóng de hǎo xiàng kū guo
items.zh: 她的眼睛红红的，好像哭过。
items.py: tā de yǎn jing hóng hóng de hǎo xiàng kū guo
items.en: Her eyes are red; she seems to have been crying.
items.why: Eyes are 眼睛, with the eye radical 目. 晴 has the sun and is for weather, so 眼晴 is the classic typo. Eye for eyes, sun for sunny.

items.s: 一直住前走，你会看到一家咖啡店。
items.s_py: yī zhí zhù qián zǒu nǐ huì kàn dào yī jiā kā fēi diàn
items.zh: 一直往前走，你会看到一家咖啡店。
items.py: yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu nǐ huì kàn dào yī jiā kā fēi diàn
items.en: Keep going straight and you'll see a coffee shop.
items.why: 'Toward' is 往, with the step radical 彳 for movement. 住 has a single 亻 and means live, so 住前走 is not a direction.

items.s: 明天会是个晴天，适合出去跑步。
items.zh: 明天会是个晴天，适合出去跑步。
items.py: míng tiān huì shì ge qíng tiān shì hé chū qù pǎo bù
items.en: Tomorrow will be a sunny day, good for going out for a run.
items.why: Correct: 晴天 has the sun 日, because it is about weather. It may look like a trap next to 睛 and 清, but sunshine is 日, so 晴 is right.

items.q: 我姐姐喜欢游泳，___每天都去游泳池。
items.zh: 我姐姐喜欢游泳，她每天都去游泳池。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie xǐ huan yóu yǒng tā měi tiān dōu qù yóu yǒng chí
items.en: My older sister likes swimming; she goes to the pool every day.
items.why: A woman is 她, with the woman radical 女; here it is my sister. 他 is for a man and 它 for things and animals. All three sound tā, so the meaning decides.

items.q: 我的新手机不见了，你看见___了吗？
items.zh: 我的新手机不见了，你看见它了吗？
items.py: wǒ de xīn shǒu jī bú jiàn le nǐ kàn jiàn tā le ma
items.en: My new phone is missing; have you seen it?
items.why: A thing is 它, with a roof 宀 over a small 匕: neither he nor she. 他 is a man and 她 a woman, and a phone is not a person. All three sound tā.

items.q: 周末我们常去学校的游泳___游泳。
items.zh: 周末我们常去学校的游泳池游泳。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ men cháng qù xué xiào de yóu yǒng chí yóu yǒng
items.en: At weekends we often go swimming at the school pool.
items.why: 游泳池 'swimming pool' has water 氵: 池. 地 (ground) has earth 土 and 他 is a person, so 游泳地 and 游泳他 are not words. A pool holds water.

items.q: 你是___国人？
items.zh: 你是哪国人？
items.py: nǐ shì nǎ guó rén
items.en: Which country are you from?
items.why: 'Which' is 哪 nǎ: 那 with an asking mouth 口 added. 那 (nà, that) only points to something, so 你是那国人 is the classic typo.

items.q: 我要的是___个蓝色的包，不是这个。
items.zh: 我要的是那个蓝色的包，不是这个。
items.py: wǒ yào de shì nà ge lán sè de bāo bú shì zhè ge
items.en: I want that blue bag, not this one.
items.why: 'That one' set against 这个 is 那 nà, with no mouth: it only points. 哪 (nǎ, which) asks a question, and 我要的是哪个 would be a question, not a statement.

items.q: 请问，游泳馆在___儿？
items.zh: 请问，游泳馆在哪儿？
items.py: qǐng wèn yóu yǒng guǎn zài nǎ r
items.en: Excuse me, where is the swimming pool?
items.why: 'Where' is 哪儿 nǎr: 哪 has the asking mouth 口. 那儿 means 'over there', which cannot be the word in a question that asks where the pool is.

items.q: 我周末常___朋友一起打羽毛球。
items.zh: 我周末常跟朋友一起打羽毛球。
items.py: wǒ zhōu mò cháng gēn péng you yī qǐ dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.en: At weekends I often play badminton with friends.
items.why: 'Together with' is 跟 gēn, with the foot radical 足: following along. 根 (root, wood 木) sounds the same but cannot mean 'with', and 很 means very.

items.q: 这家餐厅的菜___好吃，我们常来。
items.zh: 这家餐厅的菜很好吃，我们常来。
items.py: zhè jiā cān tīng de cài hěn hǎo chī wǒ men cháng lái
items.en: The food at this restaurant is very tasty, and we come often.
items.why: 'Very' before an adjective is 很 hěn, with the step radical 彳. 狠 (animal 犭) means ruthless and 根 is a root; neither can mean 'very' before 好吃.

items.q: 这件衬衫五十___钱，不贵。
items.zh: 这件衬衫五十块钱，不贵。
items.py: zhè jiàn chèn shān wǔ shí kuài qián bú guì
items.en: This shirt is fifty yuan; that's not expensive.
items.why: 'Yuan' in speech is 块 kuài, with earth 土 (a lump). 快 (heart 忄, fast) and 筷 (bamboo ⺮) sound the same, but 五十快钱 and 五十筷钱 are wrong.

items.q: 吃面条我习惯用___子，不用叉子。
items.zh: 吃面条我习惯用筷子，不用叉子。
items.py: chī miàn tiáo wǒ xí guàn yòng kuài zi bù yòng chā zi
items.en: When eating noodles I use chopsticks, not a fork.
items.why: 筷子 'chopsticks' are made of bamboo, so 筷 has the bamboo top ⺮. 快 (heart, fast) and 块 (earth, lump) sound the same, but neither can mean chopsticks.

items.q: 他穿了一件___色的运动服，很好看。
items.zh: 他穿了一件蓝色的运动服，很好看。
items.py: tā chuān le yī jiàn lán sè de yùn dòng fú hěn hǎo kàn
items.en: He wore a blue sports suit that looked good.
items.why: 'Blue' is 蓝: grass ⺾ on top, because blue dye came from a plant. 篮 has bamboo ⺮ on top, for a basket woven from bamboo, so 篮色 is not a colour.

items.s: 运动完了，他渴了一大杯水。
items.s_py: yùn dòng wán le tā kě le yī dà bēi shuǐ
items.zh: 运动完了，他喝了一大杯水。
items.py: yùn dòng wán le tā hē le yī dà bēi shuǐ
items.en: After exercising, he drank a big glass of water.
items.why: Drinking is done with the mouth: 喝 has 口. 渴 has water 氵 and means thirsty, so 渴了一大杯水 is wrong. Mouth drinks, water is thirst.

items.s: 我们在体育馆打蓝球。
items.s_py: wǒ men zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
items.zh: 我们在体育馆打篮球。
items.py: wǒ men zài tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
items.en: We play basketball in the gym.
items.why: 篮球 'basketball' is named after the basket, woven from bamboo, so 篮 has bamboo ⺮ on top. 蓝 has grass ⺾ and means blue; 打蓝球 would be a blue ball.

items.s: 我家的猫很懒，它一天要睡十几个小时。
items.zh: 我家的猫很懒，它一天要睡十几个小时。
items.py: wǒ jiā de māo hěn lǎn tā yī tiān yào shuì shí jǐ ge xiǎo shí
items.en: Our cat is lazy and sleeps over ten hours a day.
items.why: Correct: an animal is written 它, not 他 or 她. It may look like a trap because a pet feels like family, but 它 is the standard written form for an animal.

items.q: 你明天有时___吗？我想请你帮个忙。
items.zh: 你明天有时间吗？我想请你帮个忙。
items.py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu shí jiān ma wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng ge máng
items.en: Do you have time tomorrow? I'd like to ask a favour.
items.why: 时间 'time' ends in 间: sunlight 日 through a door gap, a stretch of time. 问 has a mouth and 闻 an ear, so 时问 and 时闻 are not words.

items.q: 爸爸每天晚上都看新___。
items.zh: 爸爸每天晚上都看新闻。
items.py: bà ba měi tiān wǎn shang dōu kàn xīn wén
items.en: Dad watches the news every evening.
items.why: 新闻 'news' has 闻: an ear 耳 at the door, because news is what you hear. 问 (mouth) and 间 (sun) give 新问 and 新间, which are not words.

items.q: 你工作了一天，快回家___息吧。
items.zh: 你工作了一天，快回家休息吧。
items.py: nǐ gōng zuò le yī tiān kuài huí jiā xiū xi ba
items.en: You've worked all day; hurry home and rest.
items.why: 休息 'rest' is a person 亻 leaning on a tree 木: 休. 体 has the extra line of 本 and means body, so 体息 is the classic typo. Person plus tree is rest.

items.q: 祝你生日快___！
items.zh: 祝你生日快乐！
items.py: zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè
items.en: Happy birthday!
items.why: 快乐 'happy' ends in 乐, which starts with a slanting stroke. 东 starts with a flat line and 车 has no feet; 快东 is not a word and 快车 is an express train, not a birthday wish.

items.q: 我很___我的小狗，每天都陪它玩。
items.zh: 我很爱我的小狗，每天都陪它玩。
items.py: wǒ hěn ài wǒ de xiǎo gǒu měi tiān dōu péi tā wán
items.en: I love my little dog and play with it every day.
items.why: 爱 'love' has 友 (friend) at the bottom, under a roof. 受 has only 又 at the bottom and means to receive or bear; 我很受我的小狗 makes no sense. Love needs a friend.

items.q: 爸爸吃饭的时候喜欢喝一点___。
items.zh: 爸爸吃饭的时候喜欢喝一点酒。
items.py: bà ba chī fàn de shí hou xǐ huan hē yī diǎn jiǔ
items.en: Dad likes to have a little alcohol with his meal.
items.why: 酒 'alcohol' has 酉, a wine jar with an extra line inside, beside water 氵. 洒 (sprinkle) has only 西. You drink 酒, so 喝洒 is a typo.

items.q: 看完那个电影，她流下了眼___。
items.zh: 看完那个电影，她流下了眼泪。
items.py: kàn wán nà ge diàn yǐng tā liú xià le yǎn lèi
items.en: After watching that film, she shed tears.
items.why: 眼泪 'tears' is water 氵 from the eye 目: 泪. 汨 has 日 (sun), is read mì, and appears only in a river name. Water plus eye makes tears.

items.q: 跑了十公里，我的腿很难___。
items.zh: 跑了十公里，我的腿很难受。
items.py: pǎo le shí gōng lǐ wǒ de tuǐ hěn nán shòu
items.en: After running ten kilometres, my legs feel terrible.
items.why: 难受 'feel awful' has 受, with only 又 at the bottom. 爱 has 友 there, and 难爱 is not a word. 爱 (love) needs a friend 友; 受 does not.

items.q: 我在超市买了很多___西。
items.zh: 我在超市买了很多东西。
items.py: wǒ zài chāo shì mǎi le hěn duō dōng xi
items.en: I bought a lot of things at the supermarket.
items.why: 东西 'things' starts with 东: a flat top line, then a body with two small feet. 乐 starts with a slanting stroke and 车 has no feet; 乐西 and 车西 are not words.

items.q: 多吃水果对身体有好___。
items.zh: 多吃水果对身体有好处。
items.py: duō chī shuǐ guǒ duì shēn tǐ yǒu hǎo chù
items.en: Eating more fruit is good for your body.
items.why: 好处 'benefit' has 处: its top-left is 夂, whose long sweep runs under 卜. 外 starts with 夕 (evening). 好外 is not a word.

items.s: 忙了一天，大家都想早点回家体息。
items.s_py: máng le yī tiān dà jiā dōu xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā tǐ xi
items.zh: 忙了一天，大家都想早点回家休息。
items.py: máng le yī tiān dà jiā dōu xiǎng zǎo diǎn huí jiā xiū xi
items.en: After a busy day, everyone wants to go home early and rest.
items.why: 休息 is a person 亻 leaning on a tree 木: 休. 体 has the extra line of 本 and means body, so 体息 is the classic typo.

items.s: 我们坐汽东去公园吧。
items.s_py: wǒ men zuò qì dōng qù gōng yuán ba
items.zh: 我们坐汽车去公园吧。
items.py: wǒ men zuò qì chē qù gōng yuán ba
items.en: Let's take the car to the park.
items.why: 汽车 'car' ends in 车: no feet, and a line at the bottom. 东 has a flat top line and two small feet and means east; 汽东 is not a word.

items.s: 窗外的雨下得很大，我们别出去了。
items.zh: 窗外的雨下得很大，我们别出去了。
items.py: chuāng wài de yǔ xià de hěn dà wǒ men bié chū qù le
items.en: It's raining hard outside the window; let's not go out.
items.why: Correct: 外 'outside' starts with 夕 (evening) then 卜. 处 starts with 夂, whose sweep runs under 卜. 窗外 is right: outside the window.

items.q: 他每天早上去公园锻___身体。
items.zh: 他每天早上去公园锻炼身体。
items.py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang qù gōng yuán duàn liàn shēn tǐ
items.en: He works out in the park every morning.
items.why: 锻炼 'exercise' has fire 火: 炼, from forging metal in a fire. 练 has silk 纟 and belongs in 练习 (practise); 锻练 is the classic typo.

items.q: 他每天___习弹吉他，进步很快。
items.zh: 他每天练习弹吉他，进步很快。
items.py: tā měi tiān liàn xí tán jí tā jìn bù hěn kuài
items.en: He practises the guitar every day and is improving fast.
items.why: 练习 'practise' has silk 纟: 练, like working a thread over and over. 炼 has fire 火 and is for 锻炼, working out; 炼习 is not a word.

items.q: 这家公司的新产品很___害，一个月就卖了十万个。
items.zh: 这家公司的新产品很厉害，一个月就卖了十万个。
items.py: zhè jiā gōng sī de xīn chǎn pǐn hěn lì hai yī ge yuè jiù mài le shí wàn ge
items.en: This company's new product is impressive; it sold a hundred thousand in a month.
items.why: 厉害 'impressive, fierce' is written 厉, with 万 inside the 厂 cover. 历 has 力 inside 厂 and is for 历史; 历害 is the common typo.

items.q: 我喜欢看___史书，也喜欢去博物馆参观。
items.zh: 我喜欢看历史书，也喜欢去博物馆参观。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan kàn lì shǐ shū yě xǐ huan qù bó wù guǎn cān guān
items.en: I like reading history books and visiting museums.
items.why: 历史 'history' is written 历, with 力 inside 厂. 厉 has 万 and belongs in 厉害; 厉史 is not a word. Remember: 力 inside, 历 history.

items.q: 你什么时___有空？
items.zh: 你什么时候有空？
items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou yǒu kòng
items.en: When are you free?
items.why: 时候 'time, when' has 候: after 亻 comes a short vertical stroke, then 矢. 侯 (hóu, a surname) lacks that stroke, so 时侯 is the classic typo.

items.q: 两个学生在课堂上___论了很久，最后老师也加入了。
items.zh: 两个学生在课堂上辩论了很久，最后老师也加入了。
items.py: liǎng ge xué sheng zài kè táng shàng biàn lùn le hěn jiǔ zuì hòu lǎo shī yě jiā rù le
items.en: Two students debated for a long time in class, and in the end the teacher joined in.
items.why: 辩论 'debate' is speech, so it has 讠 in the middle: 辩. 辨 has a knife-like stroke and means tell apart; 辫 has silk 纟 for braids. 辨论 and 辫论 are not words.

items.q: 这两种蓝色太像了，我分___不出来哪个更深。
items.zh: 这两种蓝色太像了，我分辨不出来哪个更深。
items.py: zhè liǎng zhǒng lán sè tài xiàng le wǒ fēn biàn bù chū lái nǎ ge gèng shēn
items.en: These two blues are so alike that I can't tell which is darker.
items.why: 分辨 'tell apart' has 辨, with a knife-like stroke between the two dots, as if cutting things apart. 辩 is speech (辩论) and 辫 is silk (辫子); 分辫 is not a word.

items.q: 我想给妈妈___个电话，告诉她我到了。
items.zh: 我想给妈妈拨个电话，告诉她我到了。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gěi mā ma bō ge diàn huà gào su tā wǒ dào le
items.en: I want to call Mum to tell her I've arrived.
items.why: 拨电话 'dial' is 拨 bō, with 发 on the right (as in 发短信, send a message). 拔 bá is for pulling out, like a tooth, and 拔电话 makes no sense.

items.q: 他牙疼了三天，今天要去医院___牙。
items.zh: 他牙疼了三天，今天要去医院拔牙。
items.py: tā yá téng le sān tiān jīn tiān yào qù yī yuàn bá yá
items.en: His tooth has hurt for three days, so today he is going to the hospital to have it pulled.
items.why: 拔牙 'pull a tooth' uses 拔 bá: hand 扌 plus 犮, the pulling action. 拨 (bō) is to dial or push aside, so 拨牙 does not make sense.

items.s: 她梳了一条长长的辫子，看起来很可爱。
items.zh: 她梳了一条长长的辫子，看起来很可爱。
items.py: tā shū le yī tiáo cháng cháng de biàn zi kàn qǐ lái hěn kě ài
items.en: She wore her hair in a long braid and looked very cute.
items.why: Correct: 辫子 'braid' has silk 纟 in the middle, since a braid is twisted like thread. It may look like a trap next to 辩 and 辨, but 辫 is the one with 纟.

items.q: 开会以前，我们___先把报告发给大家。
items.zh: 开会以前，我们必须先把报告发给大家。
items.py: kāi huì yǐ qián wǒ men bì xū xiān bǎ bào gào fā gěi dà jiā
items.en: Before the meeting, we must first send the report to everyone.
items.why: 'Must' before a verb is 必须: 须 has the hair 彡 and head 页. 必需 (bìxū, 'indispensable') has rain 雨 on top and is used as 必需品, not before a verb like 先发.

items.q: 运动了一个小时，我渴了，___要一杯水。
items.zh: 运动了一个小时，我渴了，需要一杯水。
items.py: yùn dòng le yī ge xiǎo shí wǒ kě le xū yào yī bēi shuǐ
items.en: After exercising for an hour I was thirsty and needed a glass of water.
items.why: 需要 'need' has rain 雨 on top: 需. 须 (hair 彡, head 页) is for 必须 'must' before a verb, and it cannot take a noun like 一杯水 as 'need'.

items.q: 我给他发了三次消息，他___一次也没有回我。
items.zh: 我给他发了三次消息，他竟然一次也没有回我。
items.py: wǒ gěi tā fā le sān cì xiāo xi tā jìng rán yī cì yě méi yǒu huí wǒ
items.en: I sent him three messages and he actually didn't reply to any.
items.why: 竟然 'unexpectedly' has 竟, with 音 (a sound) over 儿. 竞 (jìng, compete) has 立 over 兄, so 竞然 is the classic typo.

items.q: 两家手机公司在市场上的___争非常激烈。
items.zh: 两家手机公司在市场上的竞争非常激烈。
items.py: liǎng jiā shǒu jī gōng sī zài shì chǎng shàng de jìng zhēng fēi cháng jī liè
items.en: The competition between the two phone companies in the market is fierce.
items.why: 竞争 'compete' has 竞: 立 (stand) over 兄 (older brother), two people standing up to each other. 竟 has 音 over 儿 and belongs in 竟然; 竟争 is the classic typo.

items.q: 她长得很___她妈妈，大家都这么说。
items.zh: 她长得很像她妈妈，大家都这么说。
items.py: tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng tā mā ma dà jiā dōu zhè me shuō
items.en: She looks a lot like her mother; everyone says so.
items.why: 'Resemble' is 像: a person 亻 plus 象, since a likeness is of a person. 象 alone is the elephant and 向 means toward, so 很象 and 很向 do not mean 'look like'.

items.s: 这家餐厅给我留下了很好的印象。
items.zh: 这家餐厅给我留下了很好的印象。
items.py: zhè jiā cān tīng gěi wǒ liú xià le hěn hǎo de yìn xiàng
items.en: This restaurant left me with a very good impression.
items.why: Correct: 印象 'impression' is written 象 (the elephant), not 像. It may look like a trap because 像 sounds the same, but 像 is for 'resemble' (好像), and 印象 and 现象 take 象.

items.s: 他喝了一杯午奶就出门了。
items.s_py: tā hē le yī bēi wǔ nǎi jiù chū mén le
items.zh: 他喝了一杯牛奶就出门了。
items.py: tā hē le yī bēi niú nǎi jiù chū mén le
items.en: He drank a glass of milk and went out.
items.why: Milk is 牛奶, from the ox 牛, whose stroke pokes through the top line like a horn. 午 stops at the line and is in 下午 and 午饭, so 午奶 is wrong.

items.q: 出发的时___，天还没有亮。
items.zh: 出发的时候，天还没有亮。
items.py: chū fā de shí hou tiān hái méi yǒu liàng
items.en: When we set off, it was still dark.
items.why: 时候 'time' ends in 候 hòu: 亻, then a short vertical, then 矢. 侯 hóu lacks that vertical and is a surname, so 时侯 is wrong. Waiting (候) has a stroke more.

items.q: 孩子们高兴___唱起了歌。
items.zh: 孩子们高兴地唱起了歌。
items.py: hái zi men gāo xìng de chàng qǐ le gē
items.en: The children began to sing happily.
items.why: Between a word describing the way and a verb, the particle is 地 (de), the same character as 'ground'. 池 (pool) and 他 (he) cannot link 高兴 to 唱起了歌.

items.q: 我想___一下，这趟火车几点到？
items.zh: 我想问一下，这趟火车几点到？
items.py: wǒ xiǎng wèn yī xià zhè tàng huǒ chē jǐ diǎn dào
items.en: I'd like to ask what time this train arrives.
items.why: 'Ask' is 问 wèn, with a mouth 口 inside the door. 间 (sun inside) is a room or time and 闻 (ear) is news or smell; neither is the verb you use to ask.

items.q: 跑了一个小时，我又累又___。
items.zh: 跑了一个小时，我又累又渴。
items.py: pǎo le yī gè xiǎo shí wǒ yòu lèi yòu kě
items.en: After running for an hour, I was tired and thirsty.
items.why: 'Thirsty' is a feeling and takes water 氵: 渴 kě. 喝 hē (drink) has a mouth and is an action; 又累又喝 does not work, because 又…又… pairs two states.

items.q: 你看，___就是我们的新家。
items.zh: 你看，那就是我们的新家。
items.py: nǐ kàn nà jiù shì wǒ men de xīn jiā
items.en: Look, that's our new home.
items.why: The speaker is pointing: 那 nà, 'that', has no mouth. 哪 asks a question, and 哪就是 does not work as a statement. Pointing needs no mouth; asking does.

items.q: 我家有一只小猫，___很喜欢睡觉。
items.zh: 我家有一只小猫，它很喜欢睡觉。
items.py: wǒ jiā yǒu yī zhī xiǎo māo tā hěn xǐ huan shuì jiào
items.en: We have a little cat at home; it loves sleeping.
items.why: A cat is an animal, so it is 它 (the 宀 roof, for animals and things). 他 is a man and 她 a woman, and both would personify the cat; plain writing uses 它.

items.s: 你在找什么？
items.s_py: nǐ zài zhǎo shén me
items.zh: 你在找什么？
items.py: nǐ zài zhǎo shén me
items.en: What are you looking for?
items.why: Correct. 找 zhǎo, 'look for', has no slant on top. 我 wǒ is 'I'. Do not mark this wrong because 我 looks more familiar.

items.q: 医生说，我们每天都要锻___半个小时。
items.zh: 医生说，我们每天都要锻炼半个小时。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ men měi tiān dōu yào duàn liàn bàn ge xiǎo shí
items.en: The doctor says we should work out for half an hour every day.
items.why: 锻炼 'work out' comes from forging metal, so 炼 has fire 火. 练 has silk 纟 and is for 练习, practising a skill; 锻练 is a common typo.

items.q: 我___爸爸一起去看了一场电影。
items.zh: 我跟爸爸一起去看了一场电影。
items.py: wǒ gēn bà ba yī qǐ qù kàn le yī chǎng diàn yǐng
items.en: I went to see a film with my dad.
items.why: 'With' is 跟 gēn, with a foot 足: you go along with someone. 根 (wood) is a root, 很 (step 彳) 'very', and 狠 (animal 犭) 'fierce'. Only 跟 fits before 爸爸一起.

items.s: 今天是晴天，我们去海边玩吧。
items.s_py: jīn tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù hǎi biān wán ba
items.zh: 今天是晴天，我们去海边玩吧。
items.py: jīn tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù hǎi biān wán ba
items.en: It's sunny today; let's go to the seaside.
items.why: Correct. 晴天 'sunny day' has 日, the sun, and is written 晴. Do not change it to 情 or 清 just because they sound the same.

items.q: 明天是___天，我们去公园玩吧。
items.zh: 明天是晴天，我们去公园玩吧。
items.py: míng tiān shì qíng tiān wǒ men qù gōng yuán wán ba
items.en: Tomorrow will be sunny; let's go to the park.
items.why: Weather is about the sun, so 晴天 'sunny day' has 日: 晴 qíng. 情 (heart) is feeling and 清 (water) is clear; 情天 and 清天 do not mean sunny day.

items.q: 爸爸带我们去游泳___游泳。
items.zh: 爸爸带我们去游泳池游泳。
items.py: bà ba dài wǒ men qù yóu yǒng chí yóu yǒng
items.en: Dad took us to the pool to swim.
items.why: A swimming pool is 游泳池: 池 chí has water 氵. 地 has earth 土 (ground), and 游泳地 is not a place to swim; where there is water, there is 氵.

items.q: 他每天练习钢琴，非常努___。
items.zh: 他每天练习钢琴，非常努力。
items.py: tā měi tiān liàn xí gāng qín fēi cháng nǔ lì
items.en: He practises the piano every day and works very hard.
items.why: 努力 'work hard' ends in 力 lì, whose top stroke pokes up past the line. 刀 dāo (knife) does not poke out. 努刀 is not a word; 力 is strength.

items.q: 妈妈用一把___切蛋糕。
items.zh: 妈妈用一把刀切蛋糕。
items.py: mā ma yòng yī bǎ dāo qiē dàn gāo
items.en: Mum cut the cake with a knife.
items.why: You cut with a knife: 刀 dāo, whose top stroke stays inside the line. 力 pokes out above it and means strength; 一把力 is not a thing you cut with.

items.q: 我___你看电影，好不好？
items.zh: 我请你看电影，好不好？
items.py: wǒ qǐng nǐ kàn diàn yǐng hǎo bu hǎo
items.en: I'll treat you to a film, okay?
items.why: 'Invite, treat' is 请 qǐng, with speech 讠, since you ask someone with words. 清, 情, 晴 have water, heart, sun and cannot take 你 as an object this way.

items.q: 孩子们___点就上床睡觉了。
items.zh: 孩子们八点就上床睡觉了。
items.py: hái zi men bā diǎn jiù shàng chuáng shuì jiào le
items.en: The children went to bed at eight o'clock.
items.why: The clock time is 八点: 八 bā, two strokes that do not touch. 人 and 入 touch at the top, and 人点 and 入点 are not times.

items.q: 关___这部电影，我知道得不多。
items.zh: 关于这部电影，我知道得不多。
items.py: guān yú zhè bù diàn yǐng wǒ zhī dào de bù duō
items.en: I don't know much about this film.
items.why: 关于 'about, regarding' is 于 with the final hook (yú). 千 and 干 have no hook, and 关千 / 关干 are not words. Remember: 于 hooks onto its topic.

items.q: 爷爷每天散步，所以身___很好。
items.zh: 爷爷每天散步，所以身体很好。
items.py: yé ye měi tiān sàn bù suǒ yǐ shēn tǐ hěn hǎo
items.en: Grandpa walks every day, so he is in good health.
items.why: 'Body, health' is 身体: 体 tǐ has 本, with the extra line across the bottom. 休 has plain 木 and means rest, as in 休息; 身休 is not a word.

items.q: 我们下___三点在车站见面。
items.zh: 我们下午三点在车站见面。
items.py: wǒ men xià wǔ sān diǎn zài chē zhàn jiàn miàn
items.en: We'll meet at the station at three in the afternoon.
items.why: 下午 is 午 wǔ, whose vertical stroke stops at the top line. 牛 niú has a stroke that pokes through the top line like a horn: that is the ox, as in 牛奶. 下牛 is not a word.

items.q: 我___了好几次电话，朋友都没有接。
items.zh: 我拨了好几次电话，朋友都没有接。
items.py: wǒ bō le hǎo jǐ cì diàn huà péng you dōu méi yǒu jiē
items.en: I dialled several times, but my friend never answered.
items.why: 'Dial' is 拨 bō, with 发 on the right (发出, send out a call). 拔 bá has 犮 and means pull out, as in 拔牙, so 拔电话 is wrong.

items.q: 这本小说___好看了，我一晚上就看完了。
items.zh: 这本小说太好看了，我一晚上就看完了。
items.py: zhè běn xiǎo shuō tài hǎo kàn le wǒ yī wǎn shàng jiù kàn wán le
items.en: This novel is so good that I finished it in one evening.
items.why: 太……了 expresses 'so, too much', and 太 tài is 大 with a dot below. 大好看了 is not Chinese, and 夫 means husband; the dot makes the degree word.

items.q: 昨天的音乐会太___彩了！
items.zh: 昨天的音乐会太精彩了！
items.py: zuó tiān de yīn yuè huì tài jīng cǎi le
items.en: Yesterday's concert was brilliant!
items.why: 精彩 'brilliant' is written with 精 jīng, with rice 米 (essence, refined). 睛 has the eye radical and is only in 眼睛; 睛彩 and 晴彩 are not words.

items.q: 你最喜欢___首歌？是第一首还是第二首？
items.zh: 你最喜欢哪首歌？是第一首还是第二首？
items.py: nǐ zuì xǐ huan nǎ shǒu gē shì dì yī shǒu hái shì dì èr shǒu
items.en: Which song do you like best, the first or the second?
items.why: The follow-up 'the first or the second?' shows this is a 'which' question, so 哪 nǎ with the mouth 口. 那 would be 'that song', a statement of fact with no choice.

items.s: 她的丈夫很喜欢看电影。
items.s_py: tā de zhàng fu hěn xǐ huan kàn diàn yǐng
items.zh: 她的丈夫很喜欢看电影。
items.py: tā de zhàng fu hěn xǐ huan kàn diàn yǐng
items.en: Her husband likes watching films a lot.
items.why: Correct. 丈夫 'husband' ends in 夫, with the slant poking out above both lines. 大 and 天 do not form this word.

items.q: 这个周___我们去听音乐会。
items.zh: 这个周末我们去听音乐会。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men qù tīng yīn yuè huì
items.en: We're going to a concert this weekend.
items.why: 周末 is the end of the week, and 末 has the long line on top, the marked tip of a tree. 未 (short top line) means 'not yet' and gives 未来, so 周未 is wrong.

items.q: 请问，音乐厅在___儿？
items.zh: 请问，音乐厅在哪儿？
items.py: qǐng wèn yīn yuè tīng zài nǎ r
items.en: Excuse me, where is the concert hall?
items.why: A 'where' question needs 哪 nǎ, which is 那 with an asking mouth 口. 那儿 means 'there', so 在那儿 would be an answer, not a question.

items.s: 我听不请楚，请你再说一遍。
items.s_py: wǒ tīng bù qǐng chu qǐng nǐ zài shuō yī biàn
items.zh: 我听不清楚，请你再说一遍。
items.py: wǒ tīng bù qīng chu qǐng nǐ zài shuō yī biàn
items.en: I can't hear clearly; please say it again.
items.why: Wrong: 清楚 'clear' takes the water radical 氵 (clear water), not the speech 讠. The second 请 in 请你 is right, since asking is speech.

items.q: 我想去书店___一本新小说，送给朋友当礼物。
items.zh: 我想去书店买一本新小说，送给朋友当礼物。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng qù shū diàn mǎi yī běn xīn xiǎo shuō sòng gěi péng you dāng lǐ wù
items.en: I want to buy a new novel at the bookstore as a present for my friend.
items.why: You get a book to give as a present, so it is 买 mǎi, buy, with no extra stroke on top. 卖 mài (sell) has 十 on top: 多了就卖，少了就买.

items.s: 他把旧书都买了，换了一点钱。
items.s_py: tā bǎ jiù shū dōu mǎi le huàn le yī diǎn qián
items.zh: 他把旧书都卖了，换了一点钱。
items.py: tā bǎ jiù shū dōu mài le huàn le yī diǎn qián
items.en: He sold all his old books and got a bit of money for them.
items.why: Wrong: getting money for old books is selling, 卖 mài, with 十 on top. 买 is buying, so it cannot give you money. More on top sells.

items.q: 爷爷的生___在秋天。
items.zh: 爷爷的生日在秋天。
items.py: yé ye de shēng rì zài qiū tiān
items.en: Grandpa's birthday is in autumn.
items.why: 生日 'birthday' is 日 rì, the sun, with one line inside. 目 (eye) is taller with two lines inside, and 白 has a dot on top. 生目 and 生白 are not words.

items.s: 这个周末我想在家看书。
items.s_py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zài jiā kàn shū
items.zh: 这个周末我想在家看书。
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zài jiā kàn shū
items.en: This weekend I want to stay home and read.
items.why: Correct. 周末 has the long line on top (末, the end of the week). 未 with the short top line means 'not yet'.

items.q: ___问，去火车站怎么走？
items.zh: 请问，去火车站怎么走？
items.py: qǐng wèn qù huǒ chē zhàn zěn me zǒu
items.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?
items.why: 请问 is 'may I ask', a polite request made with words: 请 has the speech radical 讠. 清 (water) and 情 (heart) do not make 清问 or 情问.

items.q: 她的丈___在一家旅行社工作。
items.zh: 她的丈夫在一家旅行社工作。
items.py: tā de zhàng fu zài yī jiā lǚ xíng shè gōng zuò
items.en: Her husband works at a travel agency.
items.why: 丈夫 'husband' ends in 夫 fū: two lines, with the slant poking out above both. 丈天 and 丈大 are not words. Think of 夫 as a grown-up (大) with a hairpin through his hair.

items.q: 他___然忘了朋友的生日。
items.zh: 他竟然忘了朋友的生日。
items.py: tā jìng rán wàng le péng you de shēng rì
items.en: He actually forgot his friend's birthday.
items.why: 竟然 'unexpectedly' is 竟 jìng: 音 (立 over 日) over 儿. 竞 has 立 over 兄 (口 in the middle) and is for 竞争 'compete'; 竞然 is the typo.

items.q: 这部电影的___要演员我都认识。
items.zh: 这部电影的主要演员我都认识。
items.py: zhè bù diàn yǐng de zhǔ yào yǎn yuán wǒ dōu rèn shi
items.en: I know the main actors of this film.
items.why: 主要 'main' is 主 zhǔ on its own, the base character with no radical. 住要 and 注要 do not exist. 主 is the lamp's flame on a stand: the main thing.

items.q: 开车的时候要___意看路。
items.zh: 开车的时候要注意看路。
items.py: kāi chē de shí hou yào zhù yì kàn lù
items.en: You must pay attention to the road when you drive.
items.why: 注意 'pay attention' has 氵 water: attention is poured onto something. 住意 and 往意 are not words, although 住 sounds just like 注. Sound won't help; the radical does.

items.q: 为了参加音乐会，她每天都___习钢琴。
items.zh: 为了参加音乐会，她每天都练习钢琴。
items.py: wèi le cān jiā yīn yuè huì tā měi tiān dōu liàn xí gāng qín
items.en: To get ready for the concert, she practises piano every day.
items.why: 练习 'practise' has silk 纟: skills are woven by repetition. 炼 (fire) is for 锻炼 and 炼铁. 炼习 is a mix-up of the two words.

items.s: 妈妈在柜子里我她的旧照片。
items.s_py: mā ma zài guì zi lǐ wǒ tā de jiù zhào piàn
items.zh: 妈妈在柜子里找她的旧照片。
items.py: mā ma zài guì zi lǐ zhǎo tā de jiù zhào piàn
items.en: Mum is looking through the cupboard for her old photos.
items.why: Wrong: the verb 'look for' is 找. 我 is 'I' and cannot be the verb here; 找 is just 我 without the top slant.

items.q: 请给我一双___子。
items.zh: 请给我一双筷子。
items.py: qǐng gěi wǒ yī shuāng kuài zi
items.en: Please give me a pair of chopsticks.
items.why: Chopsticks are 筷子, and 筷 kuài has bamboo 竹 on top. 快 (heart) is fast and 块 (earth) a lump or yuan; 快子 and 块子 are not words. Chopsticks used to be made of bamboo.

items.q: 看到这封信，她的眼___一下子流了下来。
items.zh: 看到这封信，她的眼泪一下子流了下来。
items.py: kàn dào zhè fēng xìn tā de yǎn lèi yī xià zi liú le xià lái
items.en: On reading this letter, her tears suddenly started to fall.
items.why: Tears are water from the eye, so 泪 lèi has 氵 beside 目. 汨 has 日 (sun), is a rare river name, and has no use for 眼. Eye 目 = tears.

items.q: 奶奶把房间打扫得很___净。
items.zh: 奶奶把房间打扫得很干净。
items.py: nǎi nai bǎ fáng jiān dǎ sǎo de hěn gān jìng
items.en: Grandma cleaned the room until it was spotless.
items.why: 干净 'clean' starts with 干 gān: two flat lines and a straight stroke. 千 begins with a slanted stroke (thousand) and 于 has a hook at the end; neither makes 千净 or 于净.

items.q: 听到这首歌，我的心___一下子变好了。
items.zh: 听到这首歌，我的心情一下子变好了。
items.py: tīng dào zhè shǒu gē wǒ de xīn qíng yī xià zi biàn hǎo le
items.en: Hearing this song instantly lifted my mood.
items.why: 心情 'mood' is about the heart, so it takes 忄: 情 qíng. 晴 (sun) is weather and 清 (water) is clear; neither is a feeling.

items.s: 她把头发扎成了一条长长的辨子。
items.s_py: tā bǎ tóu fa zā chéng le yī tiáo cháng cháng de biàn zi
items.zh: 她把头发扎成了一条长长的辫子。
items.py: tā bǎ tóu fa zā chéng le yī tiáo cháng cháng de biàn zi
items.en: She tied her hair into a long plait.
items.why: Wrong: a plait is 辫子, with silk 纟 (hair braided like thread). 辨 has a knife-like slash in the middle and is in 分辨, tell apart.

items.s: 爸爸说开车的时候不能喝洒。
items.s_py: bà ba shuō kāi chē de shí hou bù néng hē sǎ
items.zh: 爸爸说开车的时候不能喝酒。
items.py: bà ba shuō kāi chē de shí hou bù néng hē jiǔ
items.en: Dad says you can't drink alcohol when you drive.
items.why: Wrong: alcohol is 酒, with 酉 (a jar with an extra line inside). 洒 sǎ means sprinkle and has only 西; you cannot 喝 something sprinkled.

items.q: 春节放假，爸爸可以在家好好___息几天。
items.zh: 春节放假，爸爸可以在家好好休息几天。
items.py: chūn jié fàng jià bà ba kě yǐ zài jiā hǎo hǎo xiū xi jǐ tiān
items.en: During the Spring Festival, Dad can rest at home for a few days.
items.why: 'Rest' is 休息: 休 is a person 亻 leaning on a tree 木. 体 has 本, with an extra line, and means body; 体息 is a classic typo.

items.q: 这部电影真___人难忘。
items.zh: 这部电影真令人难忘。
items.py: zhè bù diàn yǐng zhēn lìng rén nán wàng
items.en: This film is truly unforgettable.
items.why: 令人 'makes people feel' uses 令 lìng, with 卩 at the bottom. 今 jīn (今天) ends in a 7-like stroke. 今人 would mean 'people today', which does not fit 难忘.

items.q: 今___是我妈妈的生日。
items.zh: 今天是我妈妈的生日。
items.py: jīn tiān shì wǒ mā ma de shēng rì
items.en: Today is my mum's birthday.
items.why: 今天 'today' is 天 tiān: 大 with a line on top, like the sky over a person. 太 has a dot below and is for 'too' (太好了); 今太 is not a word.

items.q: 我不知道方___，只好问路。
items.zh: 我不知道方向，只好问路。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào fāng xiàng zhǐ hǎo wèn lù
items.en: I don't know the direction, so I had to ask the way.
items.why: 'Direction' is 方向: 向 xiàng is a house with a window, facing toward something. 方像 and 方象 are not words, although 像 and 象 sound the same.

items.q: 这道题___很难，我看了三遍。
items.zh: 这道题目很难，我看了三遍。
items.py: zhè dào tí mù hěn nán wǒ kàn le sān biàn
items.en: This question is hard; I read it three times.
items.why: 题目 'question, topic' ends in 目 mù, the eye, two lines inside and taller. 日 is the sun with one line (生日). 题日 and 题自 are not words.

items.q: 去哪儿旅行，爸爸还没有拿定___意。
items.zh: 去哪儿旅行，爸爸还没有拿定主意。
items.py: qù nǎ r lǚ xíng bà ba hái méi yǒu ná dìng zhǔ yi
items.en: Dad still hasn't made up his mind where to travel.
items.why: 拿定主意 'make up one's mind' has 主 zhǔ, the master of the decision. 注意 (zhù yì) is 'pay attention' and cannot be 'made up'; 住意 is not a word.

items.q: 他长得很___爸爸，连说话也一样。
items.zh: 他长得很像爸爸，连说话也一样。
items.py: tā zhǎng de hěn xiàng bà ba lián shuō huà yě yī yàng
items.en: He looks a lot like his dad, and even talks the same way.
items.why: 'Look like' is 像 xiàng, with a person 亻. 象 is the elephant, and 向 means toward and takes a direction, not a person to resemble. A person is like a person: 亻.

items.q: 老师说得很___楚，我都听懂了。
items.zh: 老师说得很清楚，我都听懂了。
items.py: lǎo shī shuō de hěn qīng chu wǒ dōu tīng dǒng le
items.en: The teacher explained it very clearly; I understood it all.
items.why: 清楚 'clear' has the water radical 氵: clear water. 请楚 and 情楚 are not words. Clear water, clear meaning.

items.q: 现在是七点___，电影马上开始了。
items.zh: 现在是七点半，电影马上开始了。
items.py: xiàn zài shì qī diǎn bàn diàn yǐng mǎ shàng kāi shǐ le
items.en: It's half past seven; the film is about to start.
items.why: 'Half past' is 半 bàn, with two dots on top of 二 and 十. 牛 niú has just one slanted stroke on top and means ox; 七点牛 is not a time.

items.q: 听了老师的解释，我才明___这首歌的意思。
items.zh: 听了老师的解释，我才明白这首歌的意思。
items.py: tīng le lǎo shī de jiě shì wǒ cái míng bai zhè shǒu gē de yì si
items.en: After the teacher's explanation I finally understood what the song means.
items.why: 明白 'understand, clear' ends in 白: 日 with a dot on top, the first light of day. 明日 means 'tomorrow' (literary) and 明目 'bright-eyed'; neither can take an object like 这首歌的意思.

items.q: ___面下雪了，多穿点儿衣服吧。
items.zh: 外面下雪了，多穿点儿衣服吧。
items.py: wài miàn xià xuě le duō chuān diǎn r yī fu ba
items.en: It's snowing outside; wear more clothes.
items.why: 'Outside' is 外面: 外 wài starts with 夕 and ends in 卜. 处 chù starts with 夂, whose long sweep runs under 卜, and is in 好处; 处面 is not a word.

items.q: 朋友来了，爸爸拿出了一瓶___。
items.zh: 朋友来了，爸爸拿出了一瓶酒。
items.py: péng you lái le bà ba ná chū le yī píng jiǔ
items.en: A friend came, so Dad took out a bottle of wine.
items.why: A bottle of alcohol is 酒 jiǔ: 氵 beside 酉, the jar. 洒 sǎ has only 西 and means to spill or sprinkle, which does not come in a bottle.

items.s: 她的眼晴红红的，好像刚哭过。
items.s_py: tā de yǎn qíng hóng hóng de hǎo xiàng gāng kū guo
items.zh: 她的眼睛红红的，好像刚哭过。
items.py: tā de yǎn jing hóng hóng de hǎo xiàng gāng kū guo
items.en: Her eyes were red, as if she had just been crying.
items.why: Wrong: eyes are 眼睛, with the eye radical 目. 晴 has the sun 日 and means sunny. Eyes see (目); the sun shines (日).

items.q: 一直___前走，到了红绿灯就右拐。
items.zh: 一直往前走，到了红绿灯就右拐。
items.py: yī zhí wǎng qián zǒu dào le hóng lǜ dēng jiù yòu guǎi
items.en: Go straight ahead and turn right at the traffic light.
items.why: 'Toward' is 往 wǎng, with the step radical 彳 (two slanted strokes), because steps go somewhere. 住 has a single slanted stroke 亻 and means live; 注 has water.

items.q: 我___经看完那本书了。
items.zh: 我已经看完那本书了。
items.py: wǒ yǐ jīng kàn wán nà běn shū le
items.en: I've already finished that book.
items.why: 已经 means 'already' and is written with 已, whose left stroke rises only halfway. 己 (open, as in 自己) is 'self'; 巳 is fully closed and not used here. Rhyme: 己 open, 已 half, 巳 full.

items.q: 朋友要去上海了，我们下个月再___。
items.zh: 朋友要去上海了，我们下个月再见。
items.py: péng you yào qù shàng hǎi le wǒ men xià ge yuè zài jiàn
items.en: My friend is going to Shanghai; we'll see each other next month.
items.why: 再见 'see you again' ends in 见 jiàn, a leg with a hooked foot (also 'see'). 贝 bèi ends in a dot and means shell, as in 宝贝; 再贝 is not a word.

items.s: 音乐厅的人口在后面，我们从那儿进去吧。
items.s_py: yīn yuè tīng de rén kǒu zài hòu miàn wǒ men cóng nà r jìn qù ba
items.zh: 音乐厅的入口在后面，我们从那儿进去吧。
items.py: yīn yuè tīng de rù kǒu zài hòu miàn wǒ men cóng nà r jìn qù ba
items.en: The concert hall's entrance is at the back; let's go in there.
items.why: Wrong: the way you go in is 入口, an entrance, written with 入 rù, whose long stroke is on the right. 人口 rén kǒu means 'population', which has no place at the back of a hall.

items.q: 他们的爱___故事被拍成了电影。
items.zh: 他们的爱情故事被拍成了电影。
items.py: tā men de ài qíng gù shi bèi pāi chéng le diàn yǐng
items.en: Their love story was made into a film.
items.why: 爱情 'romantic love' is about the heart, so 情 has 忄. 请 (speech) and 清 (water) give 爱请 and 爱清, which mean nothing. Feelings are always 忄.

items.q: 树上有两只小___在唱歌。
items.zh: 树上有两只小鸟在唱歌。
items.py: shù shàng yǒu liǎng zhī xiǎo niǎo zài chàng gē
items.en: Two little birds are singing in the tree.
items.why: Singing little birds are 鸟 niǎo, with a dot for the eye. 乌 wū (crow) has no eye dot, because a black crow's eye cannot be seen, so it belongs in 乌云 'dark clouds'.

items.q: 周末我想___朋友一起去爬山。
items.zh: 周末我想找朋友一起去爬山。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ xiǎng zhǎo péng you yī qǐ qù pá shān
items.en: At the weekend I want to ask some friends to go hiking with me.
items.why: After 我想 comes a verb: 找 'look up, call on' fits 找朋友. 我 is a pronoun and cannot follow 我想 as 我想我朋友一起去. 找 is just 我 without the top slant.

items.q: 周末我们去体育馆打___球。
items.zh: 周末我们去体育馆打篮球。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ men qù tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
items.en: At the weekend we're going to the gym to play basketball.
items.why: Basketball is 篮球: 篮 lán has bamboo 竹 (a basket is woven from it). 蓝 has grass 艹 and means blue, and 蓝球 would be a 'blue ball'.

items.q: 我家___在一条安静的小街上。
items.zh: 我家住在一条安静的小街上。
items.py: wǒ jiā zhù zài yī tiáo ān jìng de xiǎo jiē shàng
items.en: My home is on a quiet little street.
items.why: 'Live (at)' is 住 zhù, a person 亻 beside 主: a person lives somewhere. 往 (steps) means 'toward' and 注 (water) is 'pour', so 往在 and 注在 do not work.

items.s: 他们在辩论哪个电影更好看。
items.s_py: tā men zài biàn lùn nǎ ge diàn yǐng gèng hǎo kàn
items.zh: 他们在辩论哪个电影更好看。
items.py: tā men zài biàn lùn nǎ ge diàn yǐng gèng hǎo kàn
items.en: They are debating which film is better.
items.why: Correct. 辩论 'debate' has speech 讠 in the middle: debating is done with words. 辨 (tell apart) has no speech radical.

items.q: 她对___来很有信心。
items.zh: 她对未来很有信心。
items.py: tā duì wèi lái hěn yǒu xìn xīn
items.en: She is very confident about the future.
items.why: 未来 'future' is written 未 wèi, 'not yet', with the long line at the bottom. 末 (long line on top, the tip of the tree) means 'end' and sits in 周末; 末来 is not a word.

items.q: 看，那边的___云越来越多，我们快回家吧。
items.zh: 看，那边的乌云越来越多，我们快回家吧。
items.py: kàn nà biān de wū yún yuè lái yuè duō wǒ men kuài huí jiā ba
items.en: Look, more and more dark clouds are gathering over there; let's get home quickly.
items.why: Dark clouds are 乌云: 乌 wū has no eye dot, like a black crow. 鸟云 would be 'bird clouds'; 鸟 has the dot and means bird.

items.s: 我妈妈跟她朋友去看电影了。
items.s_py: wǒ mā ma gēn tā péng you qù kàn diàn yǐng le
items.zh: 我妈妈跟她朋友去看电影了。
items.py: wǒ mā ma gēn tā péng you qù kàn diàn yǐng le
items.en: My mum has gone to the cinema with her friend.
items.why: Correct. 跟 gēn 'with' has a foot 足; 她 is right for a woman. 根 (wood) is a root and 很 'very', so neither fits.

items.q: 我姐姐是医院的护___。
items.zh: 我姐姐是医院的护士。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie shì yī yuàn de hù shi
items.en: My older sister is a nurse at the hospital.
items.why: 护士 'nurse' ends in 士, whose top line is the long one. 土 (earth) has the long line at the bottom, as in 土豆; 护土 is not a word. Picture: 士 stands tall, the ground 土 lies wide.

items.q: 这张音乐会的票要一___块钱。
items.zh: 这张音乐会的票要一千块钱。
items.py: zhè zhāng yīn yuè huì de piào yào yī qiān kuài qián
items.en: This concert ticket costs a thousand yuan.
items.why: 'A thousand' is 一千: 千 qiān starts with a slanted stroke over the 十. 干 has flat lines on top and 于 ends in a hook, so 一干 and 一于 cannot be a number.

items.q: 等了很久，火车终___到了。
items.zh: 等了很久，火车终于到了。
items.py: děng le hěn jiǔ huǒ chē zhōng yú dào le
items.en: After a long wait, the train finally arrived.
items.why: 终于 'finally' ends in 于 yú, which has a hook at the bottom. 干 is straight, with no hook, and is the gān of 干净; 终干 is not a word.

items.q: 他喜欢自___一个人听音乐。
items.zh: 他喜欢自己一个人听音乐。
items.py: tā xǐ huan zì jǐ yī ge rén tīng yīn yuè
items.en: He likes to listen to music by himself.
items.why: 自己 'oneself' ends in 己, the fully open one. 已 (half closed) belongs to 已经, 'already', and 自已 is not a word. Remember: 己 is wide open, like a person with arms out.

items.q: 我们城市的___口有一千万。
items.zh: 我们城市的人口有一千万。
items.py: wǒ men chéng shì de rén kǒu yǒu yī qiān wàn
items.en: Our city has a population of ten million.
items.why: 'Population' is 人口: 人 rén leans on its long left stroke. 入口 (long right stroke) is an entrance, and an entrance cannot number ten million. Remember: 人 is a person walking left, 入 goes in to the right.

items.s: 我目己一个人去看了这部电影。
items.s_py: wǒ mù jǐ yī ge rén qù kàn le zhè bù diàn yǐng
items.zh: 我自己一个人去看了这部电影。
items.py: wǒ zì jǐ yī ge rén qù kàn le zhè bù diàn yǐng
items.en: I went to see this film all by myself.
items.why: 'By myself' is 自己; 自 is 目 with a dot on top. 目己 is not a word: 目 mù is the eye and has no dot.

items.q: 我姐姐很喜欢唱歌，___每个周末都去练习。
items.zh: 我姐姐很喜欢唱歌，她每个周末都去练习。
items.py: wǒ jiě jie hěn xǐ huan chàng gē tā měi ge zhōu mò dōu qù liàn xí
items.en: My older sister loves singing; she goes to practise every weekend.
items.why: A sister is a woman, so it is 她, with 女. 他 is for a man and 它 for animals and things; both sound tā, so only the meaning decides.

items.q: 我们必___带够水。
items.zh: 我们必须带够水。
items.py: wǒ men bì xū dài gòu shuǐ
items.en: We must bring enough water.
items.why: 'Must' before a verb is 必须: 须 has 彡 (hair) and 页 (head). 需 (rain 雨 on top) is 需要, 'need', and 必需 is 'essential', used mainly as 必需品, so it cannot come before 带.

items.q: 妈妈在花园里种了很多___豆。
items.zh: 妈妈在花园里种了很多土豆。
items.py: mā ma zài huā yuán lǐ zhòng le hěn duō tǔ dòu
items.en: Mum planted a lot of potatoes in the garden.
items.why: Potatoes grow in the ground, so 土豆 takes 土 tǔ (earth), with the wide line at the bottom. 士 has the long line on top and is in 护士; 士豆 means nothing.

items.q: 我们坐公共汽___去机场。
items.zh: 我们坐公共汽车去机场。
items.py: wǒ men zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù jī chǎng
items.en: We're taking the bus to the airport.
items.why: A bus is 公共汽车, ending in 车 chē, a cart seen from above with a long line at the bottom and no feet. 东 and 乐 end in two little feet; 汽东 and 汽乐 are not vehicles.

items.q: 这个电影院的___口在左边。
items.zh: 这个电影院的入口在左边。
items.py: zhè ge diàn yǐng yuàn de rù kǒu zài zuǒ biān
items.en: The entrance of this cinema is on the left.
items.why: An entrance is a mouth you walk into: 入口, with 入 rù (enter), whose long stroke is on the right. 人口 means 'population', and 八口 is nonsense; the cue 'entrance' fixes 入.

items.q: 我想___己做一个蛋糕送给朋友。
items.zh: 我想自己做一个蛋糕送给朋友。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng zì jǐ zuò yī ge dàn gāo sòng gěi péng you
items.en: I want to make a cake myself to give to my friend.
items.why: 自己 'oneself' begins with 自 zì: 目 (eye) with a dot on top, pointing to your own nose. 目己 and 白己 are not words.

items.q: 她的眼___又大又亮，像妈妈一样。
items.zh: 她的眼睛又大又亮，像妈妈一样。
items.py: tā de yǎn jing yòu dà yòu liàng xiàng mā ma yī yàng
items.en: Her eyes are big and bright, just like her mother's.
items.why: Eyes take the eye radical 目: 眼睛. 晴 has the sun 日 and is weather; 精 has rice 米 and is in 精彩. Eyes (目) can see; the sun (日) only shines.

items.s: 屋子里很热，我们到处面坐一会儿吧。
items.s_py: wū zi lǐ hěn rè wǒ men dào chù miàn zuò yī huì r ba
items.zh: 屋子里很热，我们到外面坐一会儿吧。
items.py: wū zi lǐ hěn rè wǒ men dào wài miàn zuò yī huì r ba
items.en: It's hot in the room; let's sit outside for a while.
items.why: Wrong: 'outside' is 外面, with 夕 on the left. 处 chù, with 夂, belongs in 好处 and 到处; 到处面 is not a word.

items.q: 今天的雨下得___大了，我们别出门了。
items.zh: 今天的雨下得太大了，我们别出门了。
items.py: jīn tiān de yǔ xià de tài dà le wǒ men bié chū mén le
items.en: The rain is much too heavy today; let's not go out.
items.why: 'Too heavy' is 太大了, with 太 tài: 大 plus a dot below. Without the dot, 大大了 loses the 'too' and does not work after 下得. 天 has a line on top and means sky or day; 天大了 is not the meaning here.

items.s: 天气很热，我想渴一杯冰水。
items.s_py: tiān qì hěn rè wǒ xiǎng kě yī bēi bīng shuǐ
items.zh: 天气很热，我想喝一杯冰水。
items.py: tiān qì hěn rè wǒ xiǎng hē yī bēi bīng shuǐ
items.en: It's hot; I'd like a glass of iced water.
items.why: Wrong: to drink is 喝 hē, with a mouth 口. 渴 kě is 'thirsty' and cannot take 一杯冰水 as an object. A mouth drinks; water radical = thirst.

items.q: ___然你累了，就早点休息吧。
items.zh: 既然你累了，就早点休息吧。
items.py: jì rán nǐ lèi le jiù zǎo diǎn xiū xi ba
items.en: Since you're tired, get some rest early.
items.why: 既然 'since' has 既 jì, whose right side 旡 is a person turned away from the meal, already done. 即 jí (right side 卩) is in 立即 and 即使, and 即然 is not a word.

items.s: 电影己经开始了，我们快进去吧。
items.s_py: diàn yǐng jǐ jīng kāi shǐ le wǒ men kuài jìn qù ba
items.zh: 电影已经开始了，我们快进去吧。
items.py: diàn yǐng yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le wǒ men kuài jìn qù ba
items.en: The film has already started; let's hurry in.
items.why: 己经 is wrong: 'already' is 已经, with 已 half closed. 己 is fully open and means 'self' (自己). Rhyme: 己 open, 已 half.

items.q: 爸爸每天早上看新___。
items.zh: 爸爸每天早上看新闻。
items.py: bà ba měi tiān zǎo shang kàn xīn wén
items.en: Dad watches the news every morning.
items.why: News is 新闻: 闻 wén has an ear 耳, as news is what you hear. 新问 and 新间 are not words. An ear at the door hears the news.

items.s: 我们都很爱听老歌。
items.s_py: wǒ men dōu hěn ài tīng lǎo gē
items.zh: 我们都很爱听老歌。
items.py: wǒ men dōu hěn ài tīng lǎo gē
items.en: We all love listening to old songs.
items.why: Correct. 爱 ài (love) has 友 at the bottom; 受 is only 又. Here 'love to listen' fits 爱, and 们 correctly has 亻 for a group of people.

items.q: 他在门口摆了一张小桌子，___自己做的蛋糕。
items.zh: 他在门口摆了一张小桌子，卖自己做的蛋糕。
items.py: tā zài mén kǒu bǎi le yī zhāng xiǎo zhuō zi mài zì jǐ zuò de dàn gāo
items.en: He set up a small table at the door to sell cakes he made himself.
items.why: Someone who sets up a table and offers cakes he made is selling: 卖 mài, with the extra 十 on top. 买 (buy) would not fit cakes made by himself. More on top, more to sell.

items.q: 我的手机不见了，我在到处___。
items.zh: 我的手机不见了，我在到处找。
items.py: wǒ de shǒu jī bú jiàn le wǒ zài dào chù zhǎo
items.en: My phone is missing; I'm looking for it everywhere.
items.why: 'Look for' is 找 zhǎo, a hand 扌 with a short stroke, matching 到处找. 我 wǒ has an extra slant on top and means 'I', so 到处我 makes no sense.

items.q: 这个城市里，旅行社之间的___争很大。
items.zh: 这个城市里，旅行社之间的竞争很大。
items.py: zhè ge chéng shì lǐ lǚ xíng shè zhī jiān de jìng zhēng hěn dà
items.en: Competition between travel agencies in this city is intense.
items.why: 竞争 'competition' has 竞: 立 over 兄, with 口 in the middle. 竟 (立 over 日 over 儿) is the 竟 of 竟然 'unexpectedly', and 竟争 is not a word.

items.q: 听说他不来了，我心里很难___。
items.zh: 听说他不来了，我心里很难受。
items.py: tīng shuō tā bù lái le wǒ xīn lǐ hěn nán shòu
items.en: I heard he is not coming; I feel really upset.
items.why: 难受 'feel bad, upset' ends in 受 shòu, whose bottom is just 又. 爱 ài has 友 at the bottom and means love; 难爱 is not a word. 爱 has a friend underneath, so it has more.

items.s: 他们长得很像，我差点认错了。
items.s_py: tā men zhǎng de hěn xiàng wǒ chà diǎn rèn cuò le
items.zh: 他们长得很像，我差点认错了。
items.py: tā men zhǎng de hěn xiàng wǒ chà diǎn rèn cuò le
items.en: They look so alike that I almost mixed them up.
items.why: Correct. 像 xiàng, 'resemble', has the person radical 亻. 象 is the elephant: 长得很象 would be the typo.

items.q: 这个周末你有时___和我们去旅行吗？
items.zh: 这个周末你有时间和我们去旅行吗？
items.py: zhè ge zhōu mò nǐ yǒu shí jiān hé wǒ men qù lǚ xíng ma
items.en: Do you have time this weekend to go travelling with us?
items.why: 时间 'time' has 日 inside the door: sunlight through a gap. 时问 and 时闻 are not words. Time and sun go together.

items.q: 你的钢琴弹得真___害！
items.zh: 你的钢琴弹得真厉害！
items.py: nǐ de gāng qín tán de zhēn lì hai
items.en: You play the piano really well!
items.why: 厉害 'impressive, fierce' is written 厉 with 万 inside 厂. 历 has 力 inside 厂 and gives 历史, so 历害 is the typo; the 万 'ten thousand' is the fierce one.

items.q: 今天天空是___色的，一朵云也没有。
items.zh: 今天天空是蓝色的，一朵云也没有。
items.py: jīn tiān tiān kōng shì lán sè de yī duǒ yún yě méi yǒu
items.en: The sky is blue today, without a single cloud.
items.why: Blue is 蓝 lán, with grass 艹, from a plant dye. 篮 has bamboo and is a basket; 篮色 is not a colour. Plants give blue; bamboo makes baskets.
